limitations: Matching duplicated recipes can both point at the wrong source row; mandatory source-reviewed primary-row findings remain separate.
Grouped-to-primary alignment uses exact semantic labels and qualifiers, never a first substring or array position. Unknown row schemas stay cannot-align.
Ordered multi-part support may legitimately use distinct passages; those declarations are inventoried but are not mistaken for duplicate grouped rows.
